snippet.title: Texas Oil Baron - Gameplay Trailer | Free Demo on Steam, launches February 3, 2027
snippet.description:
Build a Texas oil empire, from a single well to a field of pumpjacks.
Play the free demo and wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4712830/Texas_Oil_Baron/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=related&utm_campaign=shorts_v2&utm_content=trailer_v9

Find the oil with sonar, steer your drill underground into hidden deposits and pump them dry. Haul the barrels yourself, upgrade every pump, tank and rig, hire a crew and sign contracts. Then watch the news: hurricanes, refinery fires and tornadoes move the price of oil, and you decide when to sell.

Launches February 3, 2027.
Solo developer: Slabon Games.

#TexasOilBaron #tycoon #managementgame #indiegame #steam
